# App is running (`app_running`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Apps · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when one of the apps is running (or, with running: false, when none is).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | app or list of apps | yes |  | App patterns (exe name, path or wildcards). |
| `running` | true / false | no | `true` | Set to false to require that none of the apps is running. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: app_running
    app: obs64.exe
    running: false
```

## Notes

In personal automations only apps in your own session count; in machine automations apps in any session count.
